title: Unify project bootstrap and JSON bridge
description: Make Agent workspace acquisition tolerate legacy JSON projects and new first-turn sessions without requiring an EF project before routing.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN SQLite has no novel_projects but projects.json has projects THEN Agent project routing can resolve an existing project; WHEN first turn has no activeProjectId THEN Agent does not acquire temp project through EF before routing; WHEN EF project is missing for a JSON project THEN WorkspaceFactory can hydrate a compatible project row or use catalog metadata safely.
review_initial_requirements: Check changes stay scoped to workspace bootstrap, project catalog, and EF bridge; verify no destructive migration of JSON data occurs.
review_regression_requirements: Run backend build and focused Agent bootstrap/regression checks; verify existing JSON active project remains readable and SQLite project rows can be created without deleting files.

title: Align frontend and backend API contracts
description: Repair mismatched project, workspace, story bible, and material API contracts while preserving existing frontend page behavior.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN frontend calls workspace THEN backend has /api/workspace; WHEN frontend creates/updates/deletes projects THEN it uses /api/project contract; WHEN materials list/upload/update are used THEN request and response shapes match backend; WHEN StoryBible overview is requested THEN either backend serves it or frontend uses available constitution/volume endpoints.
review_initial_requirements: Review visible frontend API changes for user-facing breakage; ensure no marketing/UI redesign is introduced.
review_regression_requirements: Run frontend build and backend build; use static contract inspection to confirm removed /novel-projects and /workspace mismatches are resolved.

title: Unify settings and vector defaults
description: Make Agent runtime read current user SQLite settings and normalize Qdrant collection dimensions/naming enough to avoid immediate runtime mismatch.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN user has SQLite settings THEN Agent planner uses them for LLM calls; WHEN only legacy JSON settings exist THEN fallback still works; WHEN vector services use stub embedding THEN configured dimensions match service behavior; WHEN knowledge/material vector paths are documented in code and do not silently claim real semantic quality with random embeddings.
review_initial_requirements: Check secret handling does not log API keys and masked values are not persisted as real keys.
review_regression_requirements: Run backend build and inspect settings load path; verify vector dimension config matches StubEmbeddingService or adapters reject mismatches clearly.

title: Fix migration and deployment paths
description: Correct migration helper defaults and documentation-visible deployment config so SQLite/App_Data paths and dev ports match the running app.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN migration tool runs from Scripts/Migration or repo root THEN default App_Data and DB paths point to Web/NovelAgentWeb/App_Data/Database/novelagent.db; WHEN deployment script reports URLs THEN they match actual configured backend/frontend assumptions; WHEN vector migration checks database THEN it checks the same DB as the app.
review_initial_requirements: Review path handling from multiple working directories and avoid deleting or overwriting current data.
review_regression_requirements: Run migration tool help/build or dry verification against current DB; run backend/frontend build after script edits.

title: Repair regression test drift
description: Update regression test compile errors caused by constructor and AuthResponse shape changes without weakening test intent.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN AgentKernelRegression builds THEN AgentToolRegistry tests use current constructor/context setup; WHEN NovelAgentRegression builds THEN AuthResponse tests use response.User fields and current service constructors; WHEN tests cannot all execute due external dependencies THEN that limitation is recorded with exact failing tests.
review_initial_requirements: Ensure tests still assert equivalent behavior instead of deleting coverage.
review_regression_requirements: Run AgentKernelRegression and NovelAgentRegression enough to distinguish compile success from runtime failures; record any remaining external/runtime blockers.

title: Review task outcome against original request
description: Audit whether the delivered changes truly repair the reported dual-source, contract, settings/vector, migration, and regression-test issues.
acceptance_criteria: WHEN all non-review issues before this row are closed THEN perform same-model or fallback independent review against original request and evidence; WHEN gaps or overstated claims are found THEN append follow-up issues and REVIEW-02; WHEN no gaps remain THEN close the CSV.
review_initial_requirements: Verify all prior non-review rows are closed before running this review.
review_regression_requirements: Check claim/evidence alignment for: single usable project/Agent path, frontend/backend contract alignment, SQLite settings used by Agent, migration paths matching app DB, and regression tests no longer failing at prior compile errors.
